title: Flame Splitting Tsunami
summary: Xiao Yan breaks He Meng's rock defence and kills him with Octane Blast. Mu She orders every Wolf Head mercenary above Five Stars into the Magical Beast Mountain Range to find him. At the Thousand Medicine House, Mr. Yao asks Little Fairy Doctor about the treasure, and she claims she found none and points him at the Wolf Head Mercenary Company. Yao Lao takes Xiao Yan's Heavy Xuan Ruler and shows him Flame Splitting Tsunami, a low-level Di Class Dou Skill he can use only once. Mu Li and the Wolf Head company trap Xiao Yan and demand the treasure chest's key. He fights through with Vacuum Hand, the ruler and Fire Palm, then uses Flame Splitting Tsunami against Mu She's Soaring Killer Wind. He escapes and swears to repay the ambush.
